set_aside.subject: execute_function_element
set_aside.text: - execute_function_element: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST read the pinned implementation of the node with read_implementation, read every input's bytes with read_value_bytes into PortPayloads by port, take started_at from kernel_now, and call execute_function with the code, the payloads, the contract version's input and output ports and its resource_bounds; it writes no record and returns the outcome for its caller to write.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: Must FileFactsRef be removed from the PortRef inputs accepted by execute_function_element, or must a byte-reading mechanism for FileFactsRef be added? read_value_bytes accepts only ByteSource, whose exact variants are StoredValueSource and SpooledFileSource, while FileFactsRef contains facts but no readable byte source.
